newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile economy grows 5.7 percent in May vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile economy grows 5.7 percent in May vs yr ago.

text.p: The monthly government Imacec index showed the Chilean economy grew 5.7 percent in May compared with the same period last year, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
The figures showed growth slowing from a strong 6.5 percent reported in April and are in line with official forecasts.
Bank president Carlos Massad said earlier this month that May's economic growth would be over five percent.
